account.title: Account
account.description: Your spec-ai.cn cloud account. Conversations, projects and settings belong to this account alone.
account.offline: The cloud is unreachable; local data still works.
account.isolation: Each account's data is isolated: conversations, projects, provider keys, skills, MCP servers and settings belong only to the signed-in account. Switching accounts cannot reveal the other account's data.
account.adminNote: Administrators have every feature, but their data still belongs to their own account. The role is decided in the main process; the renderer cannot promote itself.
account.plaintext: OS secure storage is unavailable, so the sign-in credentials are kept in plain text on this computer.
account.localModeHint: This build runs in local mode. Account sign-in is enabled in packaged builds.

password.hint: Use 8–128 characters. Other devices will need the new password.
password.phoneTitle: This phone account has no password yet
password.phoneHint: Link an email first, then set a password at spec-ai.cn. After that you can change it here.

bind.hint: One email and one phone number per account. A code can be resent after 60 seconds.

security.revokeHint: Signs out every device, including this one. You will need to sign in again.
security.deactivateHint: Permanently disables this account and signs out every device. This cannot be undone.
security.phoneRequired: This account has no phone number to send a code to
